verdicts.label: NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: There is no evidence available to confirm or deny the sighting of crocodiles in Kukkarahalli Lake in Mysuru.
verdicts.reasoning_en: The evidence pack contains no information regarding the claim. No web search results or any other form of evidence were provided to either support or refute the alleged sighting of crocodiles in Kukkarahalli Lake.
